_comment: Minimum annotation targets per track type before the smart-collection panel stops asking. Pilot-level numbers, not a statistical guarantee.

quality_gate._comment: cv2.line(thickness=3) - used by SAM-Road's own generate_labels.py - renders ~5 px wide (OpenCV quirk), so the export width gate is 3-6.5 px and the offset gate is half-width(~2.5 px)+<=0.5-1 px quantisation.
